extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
The Brothers’ War Set Booster Box contains 30 The Brothers’ War Set Boosters. Each Set Booster contains 12 Magic cards, 1 Art Card, and 1 token/ad card or card from “The List” (a special card from Magic's history—found in 25% of packs).
Contents:
• 30 The Brothers’ War Set Boosters—the best MTG boosters to open just for fun
• 12 Magic: The Gathering cards per booster
• 1–5 cards of rarity Rare or higher in every pack
• Traditional Foil card and Art Card in every pack
• Travel back in time to command powerful artifacts and giant robots
